On June 18, 2026, I attended the [AI4X-Accelerate Conference 2026](https://ai4x.cc/) and presented my research poster.

I was delighted to receive **2nd prize** for my poster. The conference was a valuable opportunity to share my work and connect with researchers working at the intersection of artificial intelligence and science.
